home: The window was open when I came home. I left my sweater on the chair and stepped outside for a moment.
My neighbor set a plant on the sill. A towel lay beside the sink, where the open window caught the afternoon light.
I looked under the bed for the missing sock. The pillow was still on the floor, so I put it back before breakfast.
meals: The soup warmed up while we sliced a loaf. I filled a bowl and took it out to the porch.
At breakfast I ate a pear and put the rest of the fruit in a basket. Someone left a napkin at each place.
I brought a sandwich for lunch, but the soup smelled so good that we shared some by the fire.
outdoors: The rain let up just before our walk. Water dripped from the tree, and a little bird hopped across the path.
A duck crossed the river near the footbridge. We stopped by a patch of wildflowers until a cloud passed.
I rode my bike to the beach in the early evening. Nobody was left except a person collecting shells.
small errands: The library stays open late on Thursdays. I returned a novel, then walked to the bakery before heading home.
We missed the bus and decided to walk. Halfway there I took a photo of the painted wall behind a little shop.
On my way back I carried a gift for my sister. The bus arrived just as I reached the stop.
learning and work: I wrote the answer in the margin with a pencil. My classmate showed me a different way to work it out.
When we got to the last page, the teacher asked us to put our notes away. I still had a question for later.
The office was quiet after lunch. I left the letter on a desk, turned off the light and went home.
leisure: The song came on while we were cleaning the room. My brother knew every line and sang along as he worked.
I asked my friend to send me the photo from the picnic. She printed a copy for the kitchen wall.
We watched a movie in the garden after sunset. When the screen went dark, we sat talking for a while.

home: A patch of sunlight crossed the window in the late afternoon. I moved my cup off the sill before it got too warm.
I put a fresh pillow on the spare bed. Someone had left a scarf on the doorknob, so I took it downstairs.
meals: Our host served the soup from a big pot. I asked for another spoonful when she came back around.
After breakfast I cleared away the plates and took a ripe apple out for later. The berries were already gone.
outdoors: By midday the rain had stopped and the path was drying. We could hear two birds calling from a tree.
The river was high when we crossed the bridge. We turned back before the footpath reached the woods.
small errands: A sign at the library said the side entrance was open. I dropped off what I had borrowed and headed to the market.
While we waited for the bus, my sister sent me a photo of the mural we had passed on the walk over.
learning and work: I lent Maya a pencil before we took our seats. She gave it back when the last question was done.
The office was closed when I arrived, so I left an envelope with the person at the front desk.
leisure: I had never heard the song before, but by the end I could hum part of it. My friend wrote down the name for me.
We finished the movie just before sunset. Outside, the sky was changing color as we walked home.

I can book a room before we leave home in the morning.
The recipe says to spoon the mixture into the smaller bowls by the sink.
We waited outside the movie theater until our friends arrived after work.
After the show we checked the schedule for the late bus.
A river of messages filled the screen by the time we got back.
Someone read “the song” from the printed list and then turned to the next item.
I will pencil in another meeting before we leave for lunch.
The trees leaned toward the path in the strong wind last night.
She put a bowl of berries on the table and called everyone in.
